key_insight: RubriQ turns quantum circuit synthesis into an LLM generation problem and uses a rubric-based RL reward to jointly optimize correctness, hardware compatibility, and T-gate reduction.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers an HPC-scalable path to produce fault-tolerant, hardware-ready quantum circuits automatically, which is critical for practical deployment on near-term and future devices.
method: LLM generates candidate quantum circuits as code
GRPO optimizes outputs with a programmatic rubric reward
CUDA-Q simulation is accelerated on GPU clusters during RL training
evidence_signal: On benchmark tasks, RubriQ achieves 3.31x mean T-gate compression versus 2.05x for sparse-reward baselines, converges 2–3x faster, and keeps hardware-constraint violations below 1%.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurate simulation and rubric design, so transfer from benchmarked circuits to broader or noisier quantum workloads may still require careful validation.
paper_title: RubriQ: Rubric-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization for Constraint-Aware Quantum Circuit Synthesis
